body.label: Target
body.html: One space within 4 units; yourself or up to two willing allies within 2 units of it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Mark the space until the start of your next turn. Each chosen target may move 2 units toward it and gains +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks while adjacent to it.

surges.html: One target ignores difficult terrain during this movement.
One target suppresses a Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties while beside the point until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Standard
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a willing creature leaves the rally point before your next turn: it keeps the ranged Fortitude bonus until that movement ends.
